name: FlhA/FlhB/FliPQR export gate
description: The five jointly required proteins of the flagellar type III secretion export gate.

name: FliI/FliH export ATPase complex
description: The export ATPase and its regulatory partner, jointly required.

name: FliF MS ring
description: Single-protein ring.

name: FliE/FlgBCFG rod
description: The proximal and distal rod proteins together with the rod-MS ring junction, jointly required.

name: FliG/FliM/FliN switch complex
description: The three jointly required switch proteins.

name: FlgE hook
description: Single-protein hook.

name: FlgK/FlgL junction
description: Both hook-associated proteins are jointly required.

name: flagellin filament with FliD cap
description: Flagellin and the distal cap, jointly required.

name: MotA/MotB stator unit family
description: The MotAB stator family, which includes the proton-driven MotAB units of Escherichia coli and the sodium-driven PomAB units of Vibrio. KEGG assigns both to K02556/K02557, so this system evidences a stator without evidencing its coupling ion; see inst/doc/proposal-structural-gifts.md.

name: FlgH/FlgI L and P rings
description: Both envelope bushings are jointly required.

name: PilD prepilin peptidase
description: Single bifunctional protein.

name: type IVa pilin subunit
description: One pilin protein.

name: PilB extension ATPase
description: The PilB-type assembly ATPase of Pseudomonas and Myxococcus systems.

name: PilF extension ATPase
description: The PilF-type assembly ATPase of Neisseria and Thermus systems; a non-interchangeable orthologue serving the same function.

name: PilC platform protein
description: Single polytopic membrane protein.

name: PilM/N/O/P alignment subcomplex
description: All four proteins are jointly required to span the envelope.

name: PilQ secretin
description: Single outer membrane channel.

name: PilT retraction ATPase
description: PilT. The paralogue PilU is not accepted here: it cannot retract a pilus on its own, so it is not evidence of the retraction function.

name: LptB/C/F/G inner-membrane complex
description: LptB, LptC, LptF and LptG are jointly required. A protein annotated to both the component-specific LptF and LptG markers may satisfy both roles, preserving naturally fused permease architectures without collapsing the roles.

name: LptA periplasmic bridge protein
description: LptA supplies the dedicated soluble bridge component.

name: LptD/E outer-membrane complex
description: LptD and LptE are jointly required by the canonical architecture. LptD alone is not accepted as evidence of this system.

name: MnaA-class UDP-GlcNAc 2-epimerase
description: A non-hydrolysing UDP-GlcNAc 2-epimerase supplies the UDP-ManNAc donor required by the linkage unit.

name: TagO/TagA/TagB linkage-unit system
description: TagO, TagA and TagB are jointly required to initiate and construct the conserved undecaprenyl-linked disaccharide-glycerol-phosphate unit.

name: TagD CDP-glycerol synthase
description: TagD supplies CDP-glycerol for the linkage-unit glycerol-phosphate step.

name: TarI/TarJ CDP-ribitol supply system
description: TarI and TarJ are jointly required to form the activated CDP-ribitol donor.

name: Staphylococcus TarF/TarL system
description: Equivalog-resolved TarF and TarL roles are jointly required; broader TagF-like or generic TarL evidence is not accepted for this architecture.

name: W23 TarK/TarL system
description: The W23-specific TarK primase and TarL polymerase roles are jointly required.

name: TagG/TagH exporter
description: The permease TagG and ATPase TagH are jointly required for the wall-teichoic-acid exporter.

name: LCP-family attachment ligase
description: At least one accepted LCP-family ligase supplies the attachment function; individual paralog identities are not required.

name: YpfP/UgtP diglucosyldiacylglycerol synthase
description: The processive glycolipid glycosyltransferase supplies the named disaccharide anchor; a generic glycolipid-synthesis KO is not accepted as a shortcut.

name: LtaA glycolipid flippase
description: The LTA-specific MFS flippase presents the diglucosyldiacylglycerol anchor at the outer leaflet of the cytoplasmic membrane.

name: LtaS polymerase
description: The LtaS-family enzyme polymerizes the glycerol-phosphate chain; K19005 is not accepted because it does not resolve the required architecture.
